panels.title: Reactor utilization per shard (avg over time range)
panels.description: Rows: OSDs. Columns: reactor shards. Cell: average utilization over the dashboard time range. Select the test window in the time picker to see that run only.

panels.title: Reactor utilization per shard: $osd
panels.description: One copy of this panel for each OSD selected in the OSD list. One line for each reactor shard of that OSD.

panels.title: Reactor utilization (avg of shards)
panels.description: Seastar reactor utilization, averaged over the shards of each OSD.

panels.title: Shard imbalance (max - min utilization)
panels.description: High value: the load is not balanced between the shards of this OSD.

panels.title: CPU busy (cores)
panels.description: Busy reactor time per second = number of cores kept busy.

panels.title: Network rx per shard (avg over time range)
panels.description: Rows: OSDs. Columns: reactor shards. Cell: average rate over the dashboard time range. The color scale is shared by all cells.

panels.title: Network tx per shard (avg over time range)
panels.description: Rows: OSDs. Columns: reactor shards. Cell: average rate over the dashboard time range. The color scale is shared by all cells.

panels.title: Disk read bandwidth per shard (avg over time range)
panels.description: Rows: OSDs. Columns: reactor shards. Cell: average rate over the dashboard time range. The color scale is shared by all cells.

panels.title: Disk write bandwidth per shard (avg over time range)
panels.description: Rows: OSDs. Columns: reactor shards. Cell: average rate over the dashboard time range. The color scale is shared by all cells.

panels.title: Throttled ops / s
panels.description: Ops that waited 1 ms or more in the mClock scheduler, by op class.

panels.title: Avg wait per throttled op
panels.description: total_wait_ms / throttled_ops. Ops that did not wait are not included.

targets.expr: sum by (ceph_daemon, op_class) (rate(osd_osd_mclock_total_wait_ms{ceph_daemon=~"$osd"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (ceph_daemon, op_class) (rate(osd_osd_mclock_throttled_ops{ceph_daemon=~"$osd"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: p99 wait (throttled ops)
panels.description: From the throttle_wait_latency histogram. Buckets: 1, 5, 10, 50, 100, 500, 1000 ms, so the value is an estimate between two buckets.

panels.title: Total wait time / s
panels.description: Milliseconds of mClock wait added up over all ops, per second. Shows the total queueing load of each op class.

panels.title: Max wait since OSD start
panels.description: Highest wait seen since the OSD started. It never goes down; it resets only when the OSD restarts.

panels.title: Client throttled ops per shard (avg over time range)
panels.description: Rows: OSDs. Columns: reactor shards. Cell: average rate of client ops that waited in mClock, over the dashboard time range.

panels.title: Summary: cluster funnel and client locality
Cluster messenger (OSD <> OSD): share of messages sent per shard
panels.description: Each shard's share of the messages the OSD's cluster messenger sent (repops on a primary, repop replies on a replica); a row adds up to 100%. Today shard 0 sends nearly all of them. After a fix, each shard's share should follow the PGs it owns.

targets.expr: label_replace((100 * sum by (ceph_daemon, shard) (increase(osd_msgr_msgs_sent{ceph_daemon=~"$osd", msgr="cluster"}[$__range])) / on (ceph_daemon) group_left sum by (ceph_daemon) (sum by (ceph_daemon, shard) (increase(osd_msgr_msgs_sent{ceph_daemon=~"$osd", msgr="cluster"}[$__range])))) or 0 * sum by (ceph_daemon, shard) (osd_reactor_utilization{ceph_daemon=~"$osd"}), "shard", "0$1", "shard", "^([0-9])$")

panels.title: Cluster messenger (OSD <> OSD): share of messages received per shard
panels.description: Each shard's share of the messages the OSD's cluster messenger received (repops on a replica, repop replies on a primary); a row adds up to 100%. Shows which shards read the peers' connections. After a fix, each shard's share should follow the PGs it owns.

targets.expr: label_replace((100 * sum by (ceph_daemon, shard) (increase(osd_msgr_msgs_received{ceph_daemon=~"$osd", msgr="cluster"}[$__range])) / on (ceph_daemon) group_left sum by (ceph_daemon) (sum by (ceph_daemon, shard) (increase(osd_msgr_msgs_received{ceph_daemon=~"$osd", msgr="cluster"}[$__range])))) or 0 * sum by (ceph_daemon, shard) (osd_reactor_utilization{ceph_daemon=~"$osd"}), "shard", "0$1", "shard", "^([0-9])$")

panels.title: Client messenger (Client <> OSD): client ops that arrived on their PG's shard
panels.description: op_local / (op_local + op_remote) of client requests, by the shard they arrived on. Today about 100/N% on every shard: an op lands on its PG's shard only by chance. Routing ops to their PG's shard should bring it to 100%.

targets.expr: label_replace(100 * sum by (ceph_daemon, shard) (increase(osd_osd_pg_shard_op_local{ceph_daemon=~"$osd", op_type="client_request"}[$__range])) / (sum by (ceph_daemon, shard) (increase(osd_osd_pg_shard_op_local{ceph_daemon=~"$osd", op_type="client_request"}[$__range])) + sum by (ceph_daemon, shard) (increase(osd_osd_pg_shard_op_remote{ceph_daemon=~"$osd", op_type="client_request"}[$__range]))) and (sum by (ceph_daemon, shard) (increase(osd_osd_pg_shard_op_local{ceph_daemon=~"$osd", op_type="client_request"}[$__range])) + sum by (ceph_daemon, shard) (increase(osd_osd_pg_shard_op_remote{ceph_daemon=~"$osd", op_type="client_request"}[$__range]))) > 0, "shard", "0$1", "shard", "^([0-9])$")

panels.title: client_request ops executed per shard: $osd
panels.description: Counted on the PG's shard, after any cross-core hop: the real work per shard.

panels.title: replicated_request ops executed per shard: $osd
panels.description: Counted on the PG's shard, after any cross-core hop: the real work per shard.

panels.title: Share of ops that needed a cross-core hop
panels.description: op_remote / (op_local + op_remote): 1 means every op arrived on a shard other than its PG's.

targets.expr: sum by (ceph_daemon, op_type) (rate(osd_osd_pg_shard_op_remote{ceph_daemon=~"$osd", op_type=~"client_request|replicated_request|replicated_request_reply"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum by (ceph_daemon, op_type) (rate(osd_osd_pg_shard_op_remote{ceph_daemon=~"$osd", op_type=~"client_request|replicated_request|replicated_request_reply"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (ceph_daemon, op_type) (rate(osd_osd_pg_shard_op_local{ceph_daemon=~"$osd", op_type=~"client_request|replicated_request|replicated_request_reply"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Primary PGs per shard (current)
panels.description: Rows: OSDs. Columns: reactor shards. Cell: current number of PGs. Placement balances PG counts, not roles, so a shard with more primaries does more client work.

panels.title: Replica PGs per shard (current)
panels.description: Rows: OSDs. Columns: reactor shards. Cell: current number of PGs. Placement balances PG counts, not roles, so a shard with more primaries does more client work.

panels.title: Client ops in flight per shard: $osd
panels.description: Client ops being processed by PGs on the shard. Divide by primaries for the average concurrency per PG.

panels.title: Reactor kernel CPU share per shard: $osd
panels.description: Kernel time / total CPU time of the reactor thread. High on a busy shard: it is in the kernel, e.g. doing network work.

panels.title: seastar::submit_to between reactors, per shard (sent / received): $osd
panels.description: Needs crimson_smp_metrics. Seastar messages each reactor sent to and received from the other reactors: every cross-core hop, including ones no OSD counter tracks.

panels.title: Messages sent and received per shard: $osd
panels.description: Messages encoded and written, or read and decoded, on each shard: which reactors do this messenger's socket work.

panels.title: Sends handed to another shard's connection: $osd
panels.description: send() called on a shard other than the one the connection's IO runs on, counted on the caller. Stays near 0 on main: replication sends are forwarded to shard 0 before reaching the messenger, and the connection's IO also runs on shard 0. That funnel shows in the cross-core messages graph instead.

panels.title: p99 send queue wait per shard: $osd
panels.description: From send() until the message is encoded, including any cross-core hop. A shard that funnels traffic shows up here as queueing.

panels.title: Messages per flush (batching)
panels.description: msgs_sent / out_flushes. Lower means smaller socket writes and more syscalls per message.

targets.expr: sum by (ceph_daemon) (rate(osd_msgr_msgs_sent{ceph_daemon=~"$osd", msgr="cluster"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (ceph_daemon) (rate(osd_msgr_out_flushes{ceph_daemon=~"$osd", msgr="cluster"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Avg send queue wait
panels.description: From send() until the message is encoded, including any cross-core hop. Sends are not throttled, so queueing shows here.

targets.expr: sum by (ceph_daemon) (rate(osd_msgr_send_queue_wait_ms_sum{ceph_daemon=~"$osd", msgr="cluster"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (ceph_daemon) (rate(osd_msgr_send_queue_wait_ms_count{ceph_daemon=~"$osd", msgr="cluster"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Messages sent and received per shard: $osd
panels.description: Messages encoded and written, or read and decoded, on each shard: which reactors do this messenger's socket work.

panels.title: Sends handed to another shard's connection: $osd
panels.description: send() called on a shard other than the one the connection's IO runs on, counted on the caller. Op replies leave the PG's shard for the shard holding the client's connection, so this is the client-side cross-core hop.

panels.title: p99 send queue wait per shard: $osd
panels.description: From send() until the message is encoded, including any cross-core hop. A shard that funnels traffic shows up here as queueing.

panels.title: Messages per flush (batching)
panels.description: msgs_sent / out_flushes. Lower means smaller socket writes and more syscalls per message.

targets.expr: sum by (ceph_daemon) (rate(osd_msgr_msgs_sent{ceph_daemon=~"$osd", msgr="client"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (ceph_daemon) (rate(osd_msgr_out_flushes{ceph_daemon=~"$osd", msgr="client"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Avg send queue wait
panels.description: From send() until the message is encoded, including any cross-core hop. Sends are not throttled, so queueing shows here.

targets.expr: sum by (ceph_daemon) (rate(osd_msgr_send_queue_wait_ms_sum{ceph_daemon=~"$osd", msgr="client"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (ceph_daemon) (rate(osd_msgr_send_queue_wait_ms_count{ceph_daemon=~"$osd", msgr="client"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Client write (primary): avg latency by stage
panels.description: tail="all". total is arrival to reply; the stages add up to it.

targets.expr: sum by (ceph_daemon, stage) (rate(osd_osd_op_client_write_stage_lat_ms_sum{ceph_daemon=~"$osd", tail="all"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (ceph_daemon, stage) (rate(osd_osd_op_client_write_stage_lat_ms_count{ceph_daemon=~"$osd", tail="all"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Client write (primary): avg latency by stage, slow ops (total >= 10 ms)
panels.description: Which stages the tail spends its time in.

targets.expr: sum by (ceph_daemon, stage) (rate(osd_osd_op_client_write_stage_lat_ms_sum{ceph_daemon=~"$osd", tail="slow"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (ceph_daemon, stage) (rate(osd_osd_op_client_write_stage_lat_ms_count{ceph_daemon=~"$osd", tail="slow"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Repop (replica): avg latency by stage
panels.description: tail="all". total is arrival to reply; the stages add up to it.

targets.expr: sum by (ceph_daemon, stage) (rate(osd_osd_op_rep_op_stage_lat_ms_sum{ceph_daemon=~"$osd", tail="all"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (ceph_daemon, stage) (rate(osd_osd_op_rep_op_stage_lat_ms_count{ceph_daemon=~"$osd", tail="all"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Repop (replica): avg latency by stage, slow ops (total >= 10 ms)
panels.description: Which stages the tail spends its time in.

targets.expr: sum by (ceph_daemon, stage) (rate(osd_osd_op_rep_op_stage_lat_ms_sum{ceph_daemon=~"$osd", tail="slow"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (ceph_daemon, stage) (rate(osd_osd_op_rep_op_stage_lat_ms_count{ceph_daemon=~"$osd", tail="slow"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Replication latency on the primary (avg)
panels.description: repop_rtt: repop sent until each replica's reply. local_commit: repops sent until the primary's own commit. wait_peers: own commit until all replicas acked.

targets.expr: sum by (ceph_daemon, what) (rate(osd_osd_op_replication_lat_ms_sum{ceph_daemon=~"$osd"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (ceph_daemon, what) (rate(osd_osd_op_replication_lat_ms_count{ceph_daemon=~"$osd"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Avg op latency by op type
panels.description: sum/count of osd_seastore_op_lat (milliseconds).

targets.expr: sum by (ceph_daemon, latency) (rate(osd_seastore_op_lat_sum{ceph_daemon=~"$osd"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (ceph_daemon, latency) (rate(osd_seastore_op_lat_count{ceph_daemon=~"$osd"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Avg do_transaction latency by stage
panels.description: tail="all" samples only (milliseconds).

targets.expr: sum by (ceph_daemon, stage) (rate(osd_seastore_do_transaction_stage_lat_sum{ceph_daemon=~"$osd", tail="all"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (ceph_daemon, stage) (rate(osd_seastore_do_transaction_stage_lat_count{ceph_daemon=~"$osd", tail="all"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Cache hit ratio per shard (over time range)
panels.description: Rows: OSDs. Columns: reactor shards. Cell: cache hits / cache accesses over the dashboard time range.

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (ceph_daemon, shard) (increase(osd_cache_cache_hit{ceph_daemon=~"$osd"}[$__range])) / sum by (ceph_daemon, shard) (increase(osd_cache_cache_access{ceph_daemon=~"$osd"}[$__range])), "shard", "0$1", "shard", "^([0-9])$")

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: cache_hit / cache_access: extent lookups found in the cache.

panels.title: LRU hit ratio
panels.description: lru_hit / (lru_hit + lru_miss): touched extents that were already linked in the LRU.

panels.title: Data read / write hit ratio (LBC)
panels.description: hot / (hot + cold). hot = LBC hit, cold = LBC miss, for data reads and data writes.

panels.title: Committed extent bytes / s by effort
panels.description: Extent bytes in committed transactions, by effort (READ, MUTATE, RETIRE, FRESH_INVALID, FRESH_INLINE, FRESH_OOL).

panels.title: Journal and background work (segmented and RBM)
Journal trimmer: dirty and alloc journal size
panels.description: Journal bytes not yet trimmed. Exported as counter, but it is a current size.

panels.title: Background IO blocked / s
panels.description: User IO blocked by the background cleaner/trimmer.

panels.title: Segmented backend (segment cleaner and segment manager)
RBM backend (RBM cleaner and circular bounded journal)
RBM space
panels.description: available = total - journal - used.

panels.title: RBM used ratio
panels.description: Space used by live extents / total space.

panels.title: CBJ records submitted / s
panels.description: 'had to wait': the record submitter was not available. 'caused a roll': the journal rolled before the submit.

panels.title: CBJ avg submit latency
panels.description: Average over the rate window: rate(latency_total) / rate(count).

panels.title: CBJ avg record metadata size
panels.description: submit_record_size counts only the raw metadata length of each record.

panels.title: CBJ wait time / s
panels.description: Seconds spent waiting per second, added up over all records.
